# Build dependencies of the release binaries (.github/packaging/build.py). PyQt6 has wheels for every target:
# Linux x64 / arm64, macOS Intel / Apple Silicon, Windows x64 / arm64.
ManyQt
PyQt6
numpy
# OpenCV 4.x (tested API; 5.x is a new major version), HEADLESS: same modules without OpenCV's own Qt 5 / GTK GUI
# libraries (~125 MB, and two Qt versions in one process can crash). No Windows ARM64 wheel: that build runs without
# OpenCV (Qt upscaling, NumPy color detection, no face detection) - the application degrades gracefully.
opencv-contrib-python-headless
pynput  # global mouse hooks (screen color picker) everywhere, global hotkeys on Linux / macOS
pyinstaller
